name: Role
description: Role schema from AWS IAM API

RoleName.description: The friendly name that identifies the role.

RoleId.description: The stable and unique string identifying the role.

Arn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) specifying the role.

CreateDate.description: The date and time when the role was created.

AssumeRolePolicyDocument.description: The policy that grants an entity permission to assume the role.

MaxSessionDuration.description: The maximum session duration (in seconds) for the specified role.
